 import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

data = {
    "Delta_Region": [
        "Mississippi Delta", "Mississippi Delta", "Niger Delta", "Niger Delta",
        "Ganges Delta", "Ganges Delta", "Mekong Delta", "Mekong Delta",
        "Danube Delta", "Danube Delta"
    ],
    "Project_Type": [
        "Infrastructure Expansion", "Environmental Restoration",
        "Infrastructure Development", "Community Health Initiatives",
        "Flood Mitigation", "Agricultural Modernization",
        "Transportation Upgrades", "Ecosystem Protection",
        "Urban Renewal", "Water Quality Improvement"
    ],
    "Funding_Impact_Positive": [
        45.0, 38.0, 32.0, 28.0, 40.0, 35.0, 36.0, 30.0, 29.0, 27.0
    ],
    "Funding_Impact_Negative": [
        -12.0, -9.0, -15.0, -8.0, -10.0, -7.0, -11.0, -6.0, -5.0, -13.5
    ]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

df_sorted = df.sort_values(by="Funding_Impact_Positive", ascending=False)
categories = df_sorted["Project_Type"]
positive_impact = df_sorted["Funding_Impact_Positive"]
negative_impact = df_sorted["Funding_Impact_Negative"]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))

y_pos = np.arange(len(categories))

ax.barh(y_pos, positive_impact, color='#4E79A7', label='Positive Impact (Millions USD)')
ax.barh(y_pos, negative_impact, color='#E15759', label='Negative Impact (Millions USD)')

ax.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax.set_yticklabels(categories)
ax.invert_yaxis()

for i, (pos, neg) in enumerate(zip(positive_impact, negative_impact)):
    if pos > 0:
        ax.text(pos + 1, i, f"{pos}M", va='center', ha='left', fontsize=9)
    if neg < 0:
        ax.text(neg - 1, i, f"{abs(neg)}M", va='center', ha='right', fontsize=9)

ax.axvline(0, color='black', linewidth=0.8)
ax.set_xlabel('Project Type')
ax.set_title('Funding Impact Analysis Across Delta Regions by Project Type', pad=20)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("output.png")
